Straight answers

What data do you analyze?+

Your full YouTube Studio: views, impressions, CTR, traffic sources, retention curves by video, revenue breakdown by format and geography, audience demographics, and device split. On top of that, AIR's closed analytics on competitor channels in your niche, and 10M channel dataset patterns our AI agents run against your numbers.

What access do you need?+

Read-only access only. We connect to your YouTube Studio via a standard Google authorization. We can see your analytics — views, retention, traffic sources, and revenue data. We can't post, edit, or change anything on your channel.

What do I get at the end?+

A structured report covering all 10 pillars, a 30-day action plan ranked by impact, and a 45–60 minute live session where your strategist walks through everything and answers every question. If you want more involvement from the AIR team, just ask — we'll find a way to work together more deeply.

What if my channel is small?+

The audit requires at least 6 months of history and 30 videos to have enough data to work with. If you haven't met that yet, a consultation makes more sense at your stage.

What if my niche is very specific or small?+

We've covered niches from 50M-sub verticals down to channels with a few thousand subscribers in highly specific categories. The methodology doesn't change — the competitor set just gets defined more precisely.

I'm demonetized. Can the audit help?+

The audit analyzes growth and performance data, but demonetization is a policy issue that needs its own resolution process first. Until it's resolved, a big part of the audit findings won't be actionable. Our monetization recovery team handles this — they've worked through reinstatement cases across hundreds of channels. Monetization recovery →

I have a strike on my channel. Can the audit help?+

A strike affects how your channel is distributed and what features you have access to, which makes audit findings harder to act on before it's cleared. Our team handles strike resolution separately and knows how to navigate the process. Strike resolution →

I have a copyright claim or another policy issue. Where do I start?+

Copyright claims, content ID issues, and other policy situations need a different kind of support before you dig into growth strategy. Our troubleshooting team covers these cases and will point you in the right direction. Troubleshooting →

Do I need to join AIR's network?+

No. One payment, one audit. No network signup, no revenue share, no lock-in of any kind.

What results can you guarantee?+

We guarantee the analysis is thorough and the recommendations are specific enough to act on. Every report goes through a senior AIR specialist before it reaches you. What you do with it determines the result — we can't control that part. If you're not satisfied with the audit, we'll return half the price.
